messages:
Claire H: Quick heads-up — I hit a 404 from a shortlink in the runtime onboarding guide. Can someone claim a tiny PR? https://short.red/rt-onboard -> 404
LinkScanBot: automated scan: 1 dead shortlink detected in docs/onboarding/runtime.md (approx line 42)
Devon: I can take this, ETA ~30m. Want a single-line PR replacing the shortlink with the canonical URL?
Claire H: yes please. Also it shows up in the runbook; if you fix one, please patch both.
Devon: will grep for `short.red/rt-onboard` across the repo and update any hits. pinging @Zane for a quick CR when ready.
Zane: happy to review — ping me in the PR. If it's just link swaps + small CI tweak i'll +1. :thumbsup:
Devon: small question: prefer absolute (https://docs.redwood.com/onboarding/runtime) or relative (/onboarding/runtime) inside docs?
Lucy: for internal intra-doc links we usually use relative. For email/runbook snippets prefer absolute so rendered previews don't break. For this case, update docs to relative and runbook to absolute.
Omar: FYI infra/docs team — if we're replacing shortlinks, can we add a lightweight grep check in docs CI to catch regressions? Not blocking the fix but would reduce churn.
Devon: i'll add a one-line grep test in docs-ci (non-blocking, allowed to warn) and include it in the PR. cc @Claire H for visibility.
Claire H: perfect. In the PR description note: "fixes link rot; adds optional grep CI notice".
Devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/438 — requesting review from @Zane. ETA for merge: EOD.
Zane: Reviewing now, small nit on trailing slash handling, will approve in ~10.
LinkScanBot: reminder scheduled: re-scan docs in 24h after merge.
Claire H: Thanks y'all — appreciate the quick turnaround :rocket:
